subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from agent-facing `config.patch`?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so maintainer product intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Adopt Shared Feishu Preview Policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, then leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

options.title: Only Adjust Progress Wording
options.body: Keep Feishu streaming boolean-only and reduce scary non-zero exec wording, which is smaller but still leaves no supported way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow Coarse Gateway Toggle
options.body: Permit agent-facing `config.patch` writes to `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator boundary and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt Shared Feishu Preview Policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config while preserving current defaults, then leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming path and current boolean streaming surface that this decision would extend.
